scope: The standing Kasbah of the Udayas in Rabat, including the Almohad walls and principal Grand Gate, coastal bastions, the palace and Andalusian garden enclosure, the mosque skyline and mapped white residential roof mass.

terrain.notes: The coastal tiles contain 56 offshore samples below -10 m. The entire source array is preserved; mapped walls, towers and houses stand on positive absolute elevations. The water elevations in the field do not certify current shoreline or bathymetry.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The protected Kasbah is a distinct residential and fortification ensemble with Almohad ramparts and gates.
The nomination dossier identifies the Grand Gate and its position against the exterior face of the Kasbah walls.
